infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app uses the camera to capture medical images and documents for case discussions.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app needs access to your photo library to upload medical images and documents.
infoPlist.NSDocumentPickerUsageDescription: This app needs to access documents for uploading medical files and credentials.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app uses the microphone to record voice notes for medical case descriptions using voice-to-text functionality.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: This app uses notifications to inform you about case updates, comments, and other important medical discussions.
